items.title: Confirm publishing workflow and launch scope
acceptance: Choose Markdown/MDX or CMS authoring; default proposal is Git-managed Markdown.
Confirm launch languages, article topics, pricing, author identity and contact destination.
Record explicit production launch criteria.
items.notes: Working architecture and editorial defaults recorded in docs/FOUNDATION.md; business inputs pending.

items.title: Inventory URLs and capture rollback baseline
acceptance: Record current production and staging release SHAs and routes.
Capture key page screenshots and content for comparison.
Verify previous-release activation and retain the last production artifact.
items.notes: Foundation run 41666352832 captured production 9b6b41f and pre-deploy staging 20c7271. See docs/VERIFICATION-5dc591f.md. Screenshots and retained-release rollback verification pending.

items.title: Verify staging search exclusion
acceptance: Deploy prepared noindex correction and verify live HTTP header plus HTML meta.
Allow crawling so noindex can be observed; omit staging from public sitemaps and feeds.
Check Search Console for existing staging URLs; request removal if present.
items.notes: Live staging HTML noindex, header and crawlable robots passed run 41666352832; post-deploy noindex passed 41666353233. Search Console history review remains outstanding.

items.title: Resolve dependency advisories and pin supported toolchain
acceptance: Inspect npm audit, including the previously reported high advisory.
Choose supported Astro, Node and integration versions; commit one lockfile.
Clean install and build pass without forced dependency resolution.
items.notes: Completed in 7ab15f4: Astro 7.4.5, Vite 7.3.7 and Node 24 are pinned/recorded; both Astro environments build and npm audit reports zero vulnerabilities.

items.title: Create Astro static build and environment contract
acceptance: Generate complete HTML with static Astro output.
Explicit production/staging build mode; unknown mode fails or remains noindex.
Document output directory and dependency update procedure.
items.notes: Completed by run 41669486142 and commit 7ab15f4: static staging/production builds produce HTML in isolated directories; unknown environments fail; staging noindex and production indexing contracts pass. Existing deployments remain unchanged.

items.title: Port shared design and navigation
acceptance: Preserve revised copy, logo, vault image, colours and typography.
Build shared header/footer and accessible mobile navigation.
Keep JavaScript only for interactions that need it.
items.notes: Completed in d4b7994 and verified by run 41670998494: the static Astro port preserves the revised content, logo, vault image and responsive desktop/mobile navigation. Browser acceptance remains part of CC-23.

items.title: Implement bilingual routes and translation mapping
acceptance: Provide /en/ and /pl/ routes with one complete language per HTML document.
Language switch links to the equivalent translated page when available.
Define root URL behaviour and redirects from existing language URLs; no forced locale redirects.
items.notes: Completed in d4b7994 and verified by run 41670998494: /en/ and /pl/ render complete language-specific HTML with equivalent switch links; root is a neutral chooser and legacy ?lang= remains explicit.

items.title: Create service and consultant pages
acceptance: Publish clear services and a verifiable consultant biography in both languages.
Confirm package scope, prices, currency and tax presentation.
Include actual contact details and business information without invented credentials.

items.title: Define blog content collection and editorial schema
acceptance: Validate title, summary, locale, slug, author, publication date, update date, draft flag and translation key.
Reject duplicate URLs and invalid dates at build time.
Keep drafts out of production pages, indexes, feeds and sitemap.
items.notes: Completed in 91c9b2d. Astro run 41699471880 passed five contract checks, built both environments, excluded all draft metadata from production and reported zero dependency vulnerabilities. Public staging run 41699471965 verified the release SHA and X-Robots-Tag noindex controls. Evidence: docs/VERIFICATION-CC9.md.

items.title: Build blog index, topics and pagination
acceptance: Create /en/blog/ and /pl/blog/ with real crawlable article links.
Topic pages and pagination work without JavaScript; avoid empty thin topic pages.
Show accessible empty states while articles are drafts.
items.notes: Completed in 8110f51 with route fix 04672aa. Astro run 41704521685 verified crawlable bilingual indexes, non-empty topic routes, server-rendered pagination contracts and production empty states. Non-root deployment run 41709594835 activated release 4646d7b. Evidence: docs/VERIFICATION-CC10-11.md.

items.title: Build article template and reading experience
acceptance: Render article body and key answer in initial HTML.
Show author, dates, table of contents, sources and related articles.
Provide readable mobile typography, image alt text and navigation back to topic/index.
items.notes: Completed in 8110f51 and verified by Astro run 41704521685 and public deployment 41709594835. The initial HTML includes the answer, byline and dates, generated contents, required sources, topic navigation and responsive reading styles. Evidence: docs/VERIFICATION-CC10-11.md.

items.title: Configure editorial workflow and author guide
acceptance: Document how to draft, preview, translate, review and publish an article.
Use pull requests with preview on staging and approval before production.
If CMS chosen, define authenticated previews and webhook/rebuild behaviour.
items.notes: Completed in dc56e99, 44a81cb and 5f0a71b. Editorial runs 41712895138, 41713176959 and 41715415340 verified bilingual pairing, production draft exclusion and the always-on production PR gate. Main requires strict check + Editorial review statuses; production requires a separate manual owner approval. Evidence: docs/VERIFICATION-CC12.md.

items.title: Draft initial bilingual article set
acceptance: Draft three paired EN/PL articles: self-custody basics, backup/recovery planning, single-signature versus multisig.
Use direct opening answers, concrete examples, limitations and primary sources.
No seed phrases, real wallet details or unverified legal/tax instructions.

items.title: Review initial articles for accuracy and translation quality
acceptance: Check technical claims and primary source links.
Review Polish and English for meaning, terminology and completeness.
Approve author attribution and record genuine review dates before removing draft status.

items.title: Implement production metadata and canonical URLs
acceptance: Unique title/description and correct lang for every indexable page.
Production self-canonicals use https://custody.consulting only.
Reciprocal hreflang links only between published translations; configure x-default deliberately.
items.notes: Completed in 6422eb7. Astro run 41716790015 passed eight tests and verified metadata for all staging HTML plus five indexable production pages; staging run 41716789930 publicly verified the release and noindex header. Production remained unchanged. Evidence: docs/VERIFICATION-CC15.md.

items.title: Generate production sitemap and bilingual RSS feeds
acceptance: Include only published canonical production URLs.
Exclude drafts, staging URLs, errors and duplicate utility pages.
Use truthful lastmod dates; feed URLs and links target production.
items.notes: Completed in 5a0e150. Astro run 41718420172 passed ten contract tests, built both environments and verified the production-only sitemap, bilingual RSS, robots discovery, truthful dates and staging exclusions. Deployment run 41718420109 publicly verified the same SHA and noindex header through the non-root account. Production remained unchanged. Evidence: docs/VERIFICATION-CC16.md.

items.title: Add accurate structured data
acceptance: Add Article/BlogPosting, BreadcrumbList and verified Organization/Person data where appropriate.
Match markup to visible content and actual author details.
Validate with structured-data tools; no fabricated ratings or promised FAQ rich results.
items.notes: Completed in cee7c04. Astro run 41719961650 passed thirteen contract tests and validated production-only BlogPosting, visible matching breadcrumbs, the minimal public-brand Organization node, safe serialization and staging exclusions. Deployment run 41719961341 publicly verified the same SHA and noindex header through the non-root account. External live rich-result validation remains a first-published-article release check because production currently has no reviewed article URL. Production remained unchanged. Evidence: docs/VERIFICATION-CC17.md.

items.title: Apply answer-focused editorial patterns
acceptance: Begin articles with concise answers followed by reasoning and caveats.
Use descriptive question headings, definitions and comparison tables when useful.
Link sources and related services; avoid keyword stuffing and AI citation guarantees.
items.notes: Completed in 5cc0c7b. Astro run 41723290467 passed sixteen contract tests and verified answer-first rendering, question headings, neutral comparisons, bilingual parity, primary sources, contextual service links and rejection of ranking or AI-citation promises. Deployment run 41723290286 publicly verified the same SHA and noindex header through the non-root account. Both revised articles remain drafts and production stayed unchanged. Evidence: docs/VERIFICATION-CC18.md.

items.title: Optimise images, fonts and loading performance
acceptance: Responsive image sizes/formats with explicit dimensions.
Optimise hero loading and font delivery; remove unnecessary scripts.
Measure mobile performance and investigate LCP, CLS and INP issues.
items.notes: Completed in d30d8e4 and verified by staging run 41733249032: responsive WebP candidates and bounded logo transforms passed static budgets; system fonts and zero client script resources were verified; mobile lab measured 752 ms LCP, 0 CLS, 24 ms synthetic interaction and 0 ms blocking time. The non-root deploy verified the public SHA and X-Robots-Tag noindex controls. Main remained protected at 9b6b41f and production was unchanged. Evidence: docs/VERIFICATION-CC19.md.

items.title: Deliver bilingual paid consultation booking
acceptance: Make the free discovery call the primary public booking action in English and Polish. Send paid booking links manually after discovery and keep them off public pages.
Use Cal.com for scheduling, Stripe Checkout for fiat including BLIK, and BTCPay Server for Bitcoin.
Require the staging acceptance checks in CC-33 before promotion.

items.title: Adapt both CI pipelines for Astro artifacts
acceptance: Build once per deployment from a locked clean install; deploy the tested artifact.
Replace app.js-specific activation assumptions with HTML/artifact checks.
Preserve separate keys, users, directories and ports; make reruns recoverable.

items.title: Add environment-specific release checks
acceptance: Staging requires noindex headers/meta and no production sitemap exposure.
Production must have no noindex and must use production canonical/hreflang/sitemap URLs.
Fail deployment checks on draft leaks, missing assets, malformed markup or wrong hostnames.

items.title: Run staging acceptance review
acceptance: Review desktop/mobile layouts, keyboard navigation, language links, forms, articles and 404s.
Verify content is present with JavaScript disabled and links return expected statuses.
Record evidence and resolve launch-blocking issues; confirm noindex remains active.

items.title: Prepare URL migration and Caddy routing
acceptance: Map legacy URLs and anchors to their new destinations where needed.
Validate redirects, trailing-slash policy, static routes, 404 status and MIME types.
Back up Caddy configs and document rollback without affecting other VPS sites.

items.title: Approve and release production
acceptance: Owner reviews staging and authorises production promotion.
Merge approved release and deploy production-specific artifact.
Verify HTTPS, release SHA, EN/PL pages, blog, robots, sitemap, canonicals and enquiries; roll back on critical failure.

items.title: Configure search measurement and submit sitemap
acceptance: Verify production in Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools.
Submit production sitemap and inspect representative EN/PL pages.
Exclude staging from submissions; agree privacy-conscious analytics/conversion measurement.

items.title: Monitor launch and indexing
acceptance: Check availability, 404s, forms and performance within 24–48 hours.
Review indexing/canonical/language reports at one and four weeks; track staging exclusions.
Prioritise evidence-based fixes; document any AI referrals without assuming complete attribution.

items.title: Establish ongoing publishing and maintenance cadence
acceptance: Maintain a question-led editorial backlog and review outdated custody guidance.
Schedule dependency updates, link checks and recovery drills.
Review search performance and consultation conversions monthly; update dates only for substantive changes.

items.title: Approve consultation pricing and payment terms
acceptance: Confirm merchant country, Stripe eligibility, fixed EUR and PLN prices, and full payment versus deposit.
Approve bilingual cancellation, rescheduling, privacy and refund terms, including whether BTC refunds use the original BTC amount or the fiat equivalent at refund time.
Agree tax presentation, receipt and invoice requirements for both payment rails.
items.notes: Owner confirmed a Polish-incorporated business and the booking sequence: a free 15-minute discovery call first, followed by the 60-minute starter consultation at a fixed 420 PLN, payable in full at booking. Stripe account creation and verification are pending. Confirm whether launch is PLN-only, plus cancellation, refunds, tax presentation and invoicing.

items.title: Build bilingual booking pages and Cal.com slot holds
acceptance: Verify the configured Cal.com event and API support the hold and confirmation flow before integration. Record the discovery and starter event identifiers and verify that the paid event cannot be confirmed by bypassing checkout.

Make the free 15-minute discovery call the first booking step in both languages, with no checkout. Offer the 60-minute starter consultation at a fixed 420 PLN as a separate booking after discovery, with full payment required at booking.
Provide localized availability, payment status, confirmation and secure management through the private follow-up flow.
Use one expiring hold per slot across payment methods and release unpaid holds. Collect only necessary details and never request wallet secrets.

items.title: Integrate Stripe Checkout for cards and BLIK
acceptance: Complete Stripe onboarding for the Polish business and verify card and BLIK availability for the merchant account before the live pilot.

In the Custody Consulting sandbox, create a server-side hosted Checkout Session for 420 PLN (42000 minor units) against an active starter booking hold. Enable cards and BLIK via Stripe payment method settings and verify BLIK appears on eligible PLN checkouts.
Use a sandbox restricted API key and separate webhook signing secret in the backend secret store. Keep credentials out of the static Astro build.
Coordinate Checkout expiry with hold expiry. Route payments arriving after release to reconciliation without booking the slot.
Verify signed webhook events, paid status, amount and currency before confirming a booking. Process retries idempotently.
Test BLIK and card success, cancellation, failure, refunds and receipt reconciliation.

items.title: Integrate BTCPay Server for Bitcoin payments
acceptance: Configure pay.custody.consulting and generate expiring BTC invoices from the approved EUR or PLN price. Offer on-chain Bitcoin and validate Lightning for introductory calls or deposits.
Confirm only from verified settlement events. Handle late, partial and duplicate payments and reconcile approved refunds.
Keep checkout credentials server-side and document wallet recovery and settlement operations.

items.title: Verify paid booking end to end on staging
acceptance: Use test payment environments and verify EN/PL checkout, confirmation emails, rescheduling, cancellations and refunds.
Test simultaneous slot claims, expired holds, late settlement and replayed webhooks. Confirm one booking and route excess payments for reconciliation.
Verify staging noindex and document provider setup and release checks for production approval.
